import importlib.util,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
assert sys.flags.isolated==1 and sys.flags.utf8_mode==1
script,evidence,output=map(Path,sys.argv[1:4])
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('sealed_nc_measure',script)
module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(module)
output.write_text(json.dumps(module.measure(evidence,False),indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
